story_review.one_viewing_summary: Planned chain from code and board, not observed pixels. From above, a white roof pod pulls into an airport bay while a phone inset turns to Arriving, and inside the cab the wheel turns with nobody in the seat. A plan map draws the 60 square mile February area. From above, an empty car sits in a meandering brown creek, then at eye level it is lifted and carried downstream. From above, water spreads along a street around a second car whose hazards blink. The record card writes in flat, icons fill and a stamp lands. From above, the car slows toward standing water, then from the side it rolls in as 'may' lights. The remedy row is stamped. A weather limits tag pins over rows of roofs, April 20 flips and checks land. The curb returns with the door open beside the remedy card.
